definitions.prism: A solid with two parallel congruent polygonal bases.
definitions.cylinder: A solid with two parallel congruent circular bases.
definitions.pyramid: A solid whose polygonal base joins an apex via triangular faces.
definitions.cone: A solid with a circular base and one apex.
definitions.sphere: All points in three-dimensional space at a fixed distance from a center.
definitions.net: A flat arrangement of faces that folds into a solid.
definitions.cross-section: The region formed where a plane slices a solid.
definitions.lateral area: Area of side surfaces excluding bases where appropriate.
definitions.surface area: Combined area of every exposed face or curved surface.
definitions.volume: Space occupied by a solid, in cubic units.
